reviews.text: I left my cat with them for a week in August. Everything went exactly as agreed. And they sent me videos every time I asked. My cat was very comfortable in her own carrier. I would definitely leave her with them again.
Our Mastiff Obélix has been with them for a week and they were very happy, very attentive to the animals and very grateful.

I highly recommend this place for leaving your pets. At the end of July, we entrusted our cats to them, and they were fine. When we went to pick them up, they were calm, healthy, and hadn't lost any weight. The facilities are clean and well-maintained, as well as quite spacious, and all the staff I interacted with clearly cared and cared for their pets. One of my cats had a problem as soon as he left his carrier, and they immediately detected it and gave me the right advice. Access is easy, and the driveway (200-300 meters from the road) is no problem for cars. Thanks to the whole team; we'll definitely be back.
Thank you so much for your feedback. We're so glad you liked it. Best regards.

A perfect 10 experience. We couldn't be more grateful for the care our kitten Molly received. They were always concerned about her well-being and kept us informed. The warmth of the people who cared for her from the moment we picked her up until we got her back was truly impressive. It's wonderful to find a place with such professional and attentive staff who clearly enjoy working with our pets. We want to express our sincere gratitude for everything. And a special mention to the caregiver who sent us the videos; thank you for always being so kind.
Thank you so much, Antonia. It's been a pleasure providing our services. I'm so glad everything went well. Peace of mind is what's important.

We left our cat Sebastian at Granja La Luna for a few days and we want to thank them for the wonderful care he received. We were able to speak with his caretaker every day, and she sent us videos of him happily sleeping in the sun and playing. Paula speaks to them with affection, and they clearly appreciate it. We felt very relaxed during our trip, and the price was excellent. We will definitely be back!

We visited Granja la Luna, a cat hotel. We really liked it. The cat enclosures are individual, but the cats can see each other, and it's like a garden. There's absolutely no cat smell or any other unpleasant odor. Everything is very clean. This place gave me a lot of confidence. I'm visiting several to choose the best one, and this is definitely one of them.

I am very grateful. I went on a trip to A Coruña to get the new heating system for my cat fixed, and I left her in their care. They looked after her very well and would definitely leave her there again. They are very professional and give a lot of love to the cats. Thank you so much!
Thank you very much for your feedback. We will try to improve as much as possible.
The farm was excellent, and the service was very attentive and thoughtful. Thank you.
We regret your negative review. We don't know who you are or why you left a review. But ratings are free.
Excellent service! I was very satisfied and happy with the services, and so was my dog! A great environment for our pets; it's so reassuring to know we can count on you!

We just moved to Madrid and didn't know where to leave our Persian cats, Fright and Plushie. Granja la Luna came up in my search results, and their prices are reasonable. The cat rooms are spectacular compared to others in the area. The caregiver was very kind and patient with us. She understood exactly what I needed, and I felt safe handing my babies over to her.
My cat has long hair, which can be tricky. It's a shame they don't have a cat grooming service. But the rooms are super clean, and the floor is very soft, so they come back with their fur in acceptable condition. But I think next time will be even better! We will definitely visit again!

I have no words to describe how amazing Granja Luna is. We've been using their services for almost two years. We came from another country and had an excellent dog daycare, and we were afraid we'd never find one like it. Luckily, Granja Luna, with its fantastic and friendly team, cage-free environments with plenty of space for the dogs, and so much love and care in everything they do, has been a lifesaver. My only wish is that they upload even more photos and videos to their Instagram! I always love seeing Rex and Penny in the videos. It's a safe and happy place for your dogs. Our pups come back happy and exhausted after spending time at Granja Luna.

I'm so happy with the way they treat my dog, Duc. The moment he knows he's leaving in the van for the farm, he gets super excited. He loves being there, running free with the other dogs, and in the videos they send me, he looks so happy, which makes me feel completely at ease. I'm so glad I can always count on you!

Great location for animals.
The staff were very friendly; I left my dog ​​there while I was on vacation and he was like a completely different dog, calmer and more affectionate. I will definitely be back.

This is the sixth time I've brought my cat here, and it seems he's more comfortable here than at home! What peace of mind to be able to go on vacation knowing he's in such good care. I'll definitely come back every time I go on holiday.
A wonderful experience, I will definitely continue to use your services. Thank you so much for your care and kind treatment of me and my beloved Coco and Rocky. Thank you, Sonia 😊😊 …
Thank you so much for your feedback, Cristóbal. We're delighted that you were very happy with our services. We hope to see you again soon.

This was the first time I've taken my birds for a few days' vacation. They sent me videos of how they were doing, and they were very well cared for and happy. Thank you for your service. I might come back again.
Our dog had great care there. Lovely runs with adjacent yard with trees. Clean and well run. The staff are friendly and caring.

I left my two kittens for 10 days while we went on vacation and had renovations done at home, and I couldn't be more grateful for the care they received and the peace of mind you gave me by sending me videos of how they were doing. Thank you again for everything and for the love you give to our pets, who are like family to us.
We are very sorry that you didn't like something.
We left our cockatiel at Granja la Luna for about 10 days in August and we were delighted; she adapted very well and everything was perfect.

Today we went to pick up our three cats. They've been here for eight days and we're so happy. We were worried about the stress and that they might stop eating, but they came back the same, and one of them, who has dementia, even gained a little weight (he'd gotten thinner after the heatwave). Honestly, it's much better there than being stuck at home with everything closed up. The facilities are very clean and the staff are very friendly. We'll definitely keep this place in mind for the future. Thank you so much 😊 ❤️
We left our three dogs there for a week, and when we came back to pick them up, we could see how much love they received. We'll definitely be back!

I left my two cats, Linda and Venus, for 20 days. They aren't the type of cats who like strangers, and it was the first time I'd left them at a boarding facility. They came back perfectly fine; they were comfortable in their hiding places and came out at night just like they do at home. If I have to leave them again, I'd do it without hesitation.
We've been leaving our rabbit here for several years now; she has a great time and is well cared for. 🐇 …

We were delighted with our cat Brutus's stay at Granja la Luna. The place is peaceful, clean, and full of love for the animals. From the very first moment, they inspired confidence in us and kept us informed throughout our vacation, allowing us to enjoy ourselves without a worry. Brutus was cared for like he was at home and returned relaxed and happy. We wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone looking for a safe and welcoming environment for their pets!

This is the first time we've left our dog, a one-year-old red toy poodle, at a kennel. The service was excellent; we're very happy, and she left feeling great and unfazed, even though it was her first time at a dog boarding facility. Highly recommended.
Excellent service and excellent professionals. It's clear they know a lot about animals and love working with them.

Our puppy spent a few days at Granja La Luna and we saw how well cared for and happy he was.

Thank you so much, team!
Until next time.

I wouldn't take my dog ​​to this place, not once. For starters, when you call, a rather arrogant guy answers with terrible customer service. If he answers the phone like that, I can't imagine how he treats animals. 🤮🤮🤮 …
My experience with my dogs hasn't been good, which is a shame because the place itself is nice.

This is the second year in a row I've left my cats with them (20 days).

Honestly, everything is wonderful.

- Service: 10. They are very attentive to both the clients and the animals. You can tell they love their work and the pets.

- Location: 10. Although it's a bit far from Madrid, the rooms (I'm referring to the cat rooms) are ideal. They have an indoor area and an outdoor patio. They never mix with other cats, but they do sniff their neighbors.

- Care: 10. They are very attentive to the animals. They have different types of food (in case the cat is picky and won't eat). The place is very clean and beautiful.

I won't say the animals enjoy it, since they are away from their owners, but I'm sure that at Granja la Luna their stay is much more bearable, both because of the place itself, but especially because of the caregivers who pamper them and spend time with them. It's not just a place where you leave your pet forgotten.

Very happy with everything.

I'll definitely be back.

Fantastic place to leave your pets. Luis, the owner, is a veterinarian, and his whole team is fantastic. We've been bringing our dog and birds for years, and it's amazing how bright the color of our birds' plumage is when they're returned to us, and how happy our dog is every year when he comes in, wagging his tail and greeting everyone like crazy. Great work and a great team. Thank you all!
My baby kitten made some friends. The girls were watching him. They sent us videos that helped us miss him much more easily. We'll take him back if we need to. The farm has our love and gratitude.

1 star, and only because I can't give it 0.
Because the treatment of animals is shameful. They're covering up negligence such as deaths, injuries, or escapes, and the owner isn't informed of anything, only being surprised when you go to pick up your pet. The workers lack even the most basic knowledge of animal care, so simply petting and cuddling an animal isn't enough. They need a good foundation of nutrition and various other care that they're unfamiliar with (such as administering treatment if necessary).
A surprise inspection is needed.

Granja La Luna is awesome. Our cat Mitsos is delighted to live there for a month each summer. The service level is very high and the people are very friendly and professional. And Mrs. Paola is the best!!! Always happy and smiling, despite the stress of work. Thank you Granja La Luna!!!!
Hotel in need of renovation. Magnificent staff, wonderful spa and super professional and polite masseuses. Outdoor dining in 40-degree heat is unfeasible, very poorly organized.
We left my guinea pig Garbanzo for about 4/5 days and they took great care of him, no complaints!

I left my dog ​​Chiko for a week at Luna Farm and it was fantastic! He had a blast. They put the dogs with other dogs who get along well and keep a close eye on them in the play area. They also have a pick-up and drop-off service (for an extra €20), which is great if you need it. I asked them to deliver him to my house and everything was perfect. I'm very happy, and thank you all for taking such good care of him!
Thank you so much, Rubén! It was a pleasure serving you at Granja la Luna. Caring for your pets and providing you with peace of mind is our priority. We hope to see you again soon!
Excellent care for the animals. Optimal value for money.
I always leave my expert there and I'm very happy with all the staff. Thank you for taking care of us experts.

I have two kittens, Telma and Louise! And La Luna farm has become their second home. I'm delighted with their facilities, their transport service, and the kindness and professionalism of Paula and Arantxa :)
It's the first time I've taken my cat and I'll definitely be back.
Thank you very much, Margarita. We want Granja La Luna to be a very pleasant place.

The Mini Zoo (two dogs and one cat) has been picked up 22 days later in perfect physical and emotional condition. Thanks to the staff at La Granja de la Luna and to our main caregiver, Paula, for trusting in your care for the past five years.

Thanks again, Paula, and all the caregivers. Our dear Nym is having a wonderful time. When she sees you, she's so happy because she knows she's cared for and loved. We're leaving happy and confident that our Nymeria is in the best hands. HAPPY HOLIDAYS TO ALL. Thank you so much.
Lovely people who truly care for the animals in a beautiful setting.

This was the second time we've taken our bunny Nube and it was even better than the first... she was well cared for, comfortable, and had more than enough space, and we were relaxed... the price was very reasonable, Mónica and Diana were fantastic... little more to add, a 10/10 experience

Granja de la luna has been taking care of my cat Tiger during our vacations probably for the last 8-10 years. More recently for Easter  vacation I have also left my new little rescue cat Lia there. The installations for the cats are great. Each one has its own gated enclosure with outside/inside space. The dog kennels are further away from the cats, which is a very thoughtful set up. All the staff  I met is very  helpful and friendly. Arantxa who has been picking up my Tiger for many years is super nice always talking to Tiger :). I was so worried to leave my new little rescue cat Lia for the first time there, but each time I called the Granja, the staff has been very supportive. When she was not eating (only initially) they offered her canned food and made sure she was fine. My experience over the years has been great. The staff has been very helpful to our needs. I also recall, during the Covid pandemic i had to extent the stay of my cat Tiger at the Granja to three weeks, and he was very well taken care off.
We left our cat there and we're thrilled. Monica and Diana provided exceptional service.
Our cats Coco and Bella have been here many times. Everything's always great. Now with Monica and Diana. Lovely 😊😊 …
We're very happy with Mónica and Diana; they're lovely and it's clear they treat the animals very well. It's a beautiful place and our rabbit was delighted :)

The facilities are very well maintained, the welcome is very warm, and they were very affectionate with our furry friend, playing with him the whole time.
They adapt very well to your pet's personality, and what we appreciated most and what reassured us was that they sent us a video showing how much fun he was having. If needed, we will definitely use them again.
The best place to leave your beloved pet, without a doubt. 👍 …

Thank you so much for your feedback. We're so glad you like Granja la Luna... The dog boarding facility has been growing, focusing not only on your dog's well-being but also on providing an enriching and balanced experience for them. We hope to see you at La Luna very soon!

It's a pleasure to care for your Malinois. He takes care of us all... Duke is a very special dog. He has enormous sensitivity; he understands gestures, but also feelings. He must be handled with balance and sensitivity.
Thank you so much! The cat really had a wonderful time. Very affectionate and curious.

This is the best Dog Kennel in Madrid! From the client service who communicated with me via WhatsApp to the lady who picked up Aujun today, they are super friendly and kind. It is the first time my dog stays in the Kennel and I was very worried how he reacts to strangers and other dogs. They are so thoughtful and sent me a video of Aujun. They are very good with dogs for sure and kind people. Highly recommended! Annie
We're so glad you liked it. Thank you so much!

I'm giving it one star because I can't give it zero. They don't allow potentially dangerous dogs (PPP) to be mixed with other dogs; they keep them alone and unsocialized, while they watch other dogs play amongst themselves, regardless of …

Excellent service and attention!
This is the third time I've left my dog ​​at Granja La Luna whenever I have to travel for work or vacation. …

Don't take your pets here. My dog ​​was perfectly fine and came back with wounds. I gave them bags of food for my dog, and they returned them untouched! My dog ​​is thinner now; I have a feeling they haven't been feeding him properly. …

Complete disappointment, the worst experience we could have had. The dog arrived scared, thirsty, and extremely hungry. I've attached photos showing that they didn't give him all the food I sent (I sent the exact amount). He has wounds on …
